items.contract: Request export, identify the accepted school and revisions, create and verify the exact ZIP, deliver it, and retain the same baseline.
items.actorBoundary: Real Chrome, loopback HTTP, PostgreSQL, packaged verify, and UC-1 re-import
items.claim: The native action returns a verified canonical archive that re-imports to the exact baseline.

evidence.observation: Chrome asserts school and both revisions and receives a ZIP; HTTP asserts entry order, exact documents and provenance, verification calls, unchanged state, and exact re-import.

negativeObligations: Export does not mutate accepted state

items.contract: Without accepted state refuse export and expose no candidate as current.
items.claim: The response is a safe conflict problem with no attachment.

evidence.observation: Assertions observe 409 ACCEPTED_BASELINE_REQUIRED, no assignments or Content-Disposition, and exact EMPTY version 0 state.

items.contract: Archive creation failure reports incomplete export and publishes no partial archive.
items.actorBoundary: Injected ZIP writer failure through HTTP
items.claim: Creation failure is safe and preserves the baseline.

evidence.observation: Injected IOException returns 503 EXPORT_FAILED without Content-Disposition and the complete document is unchanged.

items.contract: Verification failure rejects the completed archive with a safe integrity reason.
items.actorBoundary: Corrupt completed ZIP through bounded verifier path
items.claim: Corruption is detected before publication.

evidence.observation: Corrupt output returns 422 EXPORT_VERIFICATION_FAILED without attachment and the complete document is unchanged.

items.contract: Export contains accepted data only.
items.actorBoundary: ZIP root entries and parsed values
items.claim: Only the three accepted-baseline documents are present.

evidence.observation: Assertions compare the exact ordered entry names and each parsed value to acceptedBaseline fields.

items.contract: Content, versions, revisions, and lock provenance are exact or export fails.
items.actorBoundary: Canonical ZIP parse, packaged verify, manifest validation, and re-import
items.claim: Exact values and ATTEMPT_SCOPED provenance survive the round trip.

evidence.observation: A locked baseline is exported; all documents and revisions are compared, ATTEMPT_SCOPED is asserted, and re-imported baseline equality is exact.

items.contract: Export makes no outbound request or automatic distribution.
items.actorBoundary: Same-origin UI and local service/process dependencies
items.claim: Only the explicit local GET triggers local archive creation and packaged verification.

evidence.observation: The UI has a same-origin download link; Chrome explicitly fetches it; service dependencies are local repository, memory archiver, parser, manifest validator, and packaged verifier.

items.contract: Export never mutates workspace state or accepted data.
items.actorBoundary: PostgreSQL snapshots for success and failures
items.claim: All outcomes are read-only.

evidence.observation: Every outcome compares the complete document before and after; successful response retains ETag ws-1.

items.contract: One verified archive reproduces the same accepted baseline through UC-1.
items.actorBoundary: Export response followed by production UC-1 import
items.claim: Downloaded bytes recreate the same definition, result, and manifest.

evidence.observation: After reset, POST /api/import accepts the export, invokes packaged verify, and stores an equal acceptedBaseline.

items.contract: Failure or refusal produces no archive represented complete and leaves state unchanged.
items.claim: Every non-success has no attachment and no mutation.

evidence.observation: 409, 503, and 422 outcomes omit Content-Disposition and retain exact lifecycle, version, and document.

items.contract: Export consumes accepted state from UC-1 and must be re-importable through UC-1.
items.actorBoundary: Approved production import and accepted aggregate
items.claim: The production UC-1 path establishes and reproduces the baseline.

evidence.observation: UC-1 is APPROVED; the test imports, exports, resets, and re-imports through production routes.

negativeObligations: EMPTY is not treated as accepted

items.contract: Reactor modules preserve the packaged process boundary.
items.claim: UC-8 adds no kernel implementation linkage.

evidence.observation: 170 tests and architecture checks pass; export calls KernelVerifier.

items.contract: Pinned Java, Spring, PostgreSQL, and dependency baseline remains unchanged.
items.claim: UC-8 uses the existing stack without dependencies.

evidence.observation: No POM changed; 170 tests pass with zero failures, errors, or skips.

items.contract: The singleton JSONB aggregate is the sole authority.
items.claim: Export reads once and never writes.

evidence.observation: Service calls load; all tests compare exact documents and versions.

items.contract: Canonical JSON preserves document fidelity.
items.actorBoundary: Canonical serializer, parser, and round trip
items.claim: Each document is canonicalized and compared canonically.

evidence.observation: Entries use CanonicalJson.bytes; parsed canonical bytes and re-imported JSON are equal.

items.contract: Structured verify validates the baseline without solving.
items.claim: Only matching VERIFIED evidence permits export.

evidence.observation: Service compares verifier school/input/timetable identities; invocation counts prove export and re-import verification.

items.contract: Verifier process files and diagnostics are private and bounded.

evidence.observation: Permissions, bounded output, explicit paths, no-debug, and cleanup checks pass.

items.contract: Archive parsing is exact, bounded, and extraction-free.

evidence.observation: Linked order matches asserted ZIP order; strict manifest equals stored data and retains ATTEMPT_SCOPED.

items.contract: Export is a same-origin loopback route without CORS or identity.

evidence.observation: GET route is permitted, Chrome fetches same-origin, and the full security matrix passes.

items.contract: Failures use stable safe problems.

evidence.observation: Assertions verify codes and statuses, no assignments, and no attachment.
